{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Chicanery''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ramsey Lanclo]]. While running a cargo of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]], the ship was boarded by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] agent [[Hewat]]. The quick thinking of Lanclo's [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]], [[XDL-67]], distracted Hewat from the contraband by gifting her a [[marsupial]] [[keon]] to give to her daughter, [[Kora]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
